_doc: Ordered manifest of database/raw files that db:apply-raw applies. This is deliberately an explicit list, not a directory glob: ci.yml globs the directory and swallows every error with `|| true`, which is fine against a throwaway Postgres and unacceptable against a real one. A file earns its place here by being idempotent and re-run-safe, and by declaring the relations it operates on so a database that lacks them is reported rather than half-applied. Everything still outside this list has never run on Azure; `db:check-raw-parity` is what says so out loud.

files.note: Phase 0 RLS enable + tenant_isolation policies on the workspace/audit/workflow/outbox/usage tables.
workspace_id column + backfill + NOT NULL + FK CASCADE + strict RLS on the five highest-traffic silver tables.
Sweeps the rest of the silver schema (tiers B/C/D).
audit / ops / workflow / targeting, including per-partition ENABLE+FORCE which RLS does not inherit.
Refines the audit/workflow parent policies Block 3 left too strict for operator reads.
